requirement.normalizedRequirement: chapter_9_1_applicable = true IF (ship_type = fishing_vessel AND length_overall_m >= 24) OR (ship_type = pleasure_yacht AND gross_tonnage >= 300 AND engaged_in_trade = false) OR (ship_type = cargo_ship AND 300 <= gross_tonnage < 500).
requirement.requiredInputs: Ship type, length overall, gross tonnage, and trade status
requirement.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirement.sourceText: This chapter applies to: fishing vessels of 24 metres in length overall and above; pleasure yachts of 300 gross tonnage and upwards not engaged in trade; and cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and upwards but below 500 gross tonnage.
